h1.en: Keep concrete pump 60 which model to order under “The Enthalpy Difference” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「焓 差」下保留搜索“60”：邢台有四张页用到这个数字，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump 60 which model to order. The row to open is /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. LZ-60, not Diesel 60. None of these four pages prints 60 m³/h. Do not ask for a blended “60 m³/h” machine. Diesel 60 and LZ-60 both print HBT60-13.132. Electric 60 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and hopper 0.7 m³. LZ-60 prints the same string with 145 kW, 50 m³/h and 5500 kg. A label printed on the Electric Low Pressure 60 page beside 75 kW. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h and the string HBT60-13.132. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not collapse the number 60 into one pump. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW, the label Electric 75-60, 35 m³/h and hopper 0.5 m³. Diesel 60 then prints 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m, 3500 kg and no aggregate cell. LZ-60 prints 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 5500 kg. The section title “Calculating Enthalpy” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是搜索“60”：邢台有四张页用到这个数字的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。LZ-60，不是柴油60。这四页都没有印 60 m³/h。不要要一台混合出来的“60 m³/h”机器。河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把数字 60 并成一台泵。印在电动低压60页上、靠着 75 kW 的一个标注。柴油60和 LZ-60 都印 HBT60-13.132。电动60印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、3300 kg。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。电动低压60印 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。LZ-60 印同一字符串，但是 145 kW、50 m³/h、5500 kg。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h 和字符串 HBT60-13.132。电动低压60印 75 kW、标注 Electric 75-60、35 m³/h、料斗 0.5 m³。柴油60随后印 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，并且没有骨料格。LZ-60 印 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、5500 kg。节标题「计算 焓」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.en: Increase in Temperature when Heating Air
heading.zh: 升高 在 温度 当 加热 空气

LZ-60 prints the same string with 145 kW, 50 m³/h and 5500 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not collapse the number 60 into one pump.
